_about: Headwear sits over any hair in one of three ways, each set on the part's SVG root and repeated here.
hairClip: Brimmed hats (beanie, cap, bucket hat): data-hair-clip is a path in the 256 viewBox. The renderer adds <clipPath id="hair-clip"><path d="..."/></clipPath> to defs and clip-path="url(#hair-clip)" to the back-hair and front-hair layer groups, so hair shows only below the brim: long hair, an afro's sides and a ponytail still come out from under the hat, and nothing pokes through above it.
hides: Wraps that cover all the hair as worn (headwrap, turban, patka): data-hides="back-hair front-hair". Ears stay. A hides from a layer that is itself hidden should not count (a hijab under a turban must not take the ears away).
anchor: kippah: data-anchor="crown". It is drawn for a crown at y 60, its rim the curve y = crown + 2 + 0.0125 dx^2 that hair tops follow; the renderer wraps it in transform="translate(0, crown - 60)", where crown is the drawn hair part's data-crown (62 when no hair draws). Each hair's data-crown is measured from its outline (scratch-hair/measure.mjs) so the rim overlaps the hair by at least 1.5 units, about 2 at the centre.
